items.title: Taquari (RS) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #3
items.en_title: Taquari (RS) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #3
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Taquari (RS) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 20,000; proposals close Nov 24 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
